name: Silkwing · Gremlet #18
description:
A fuzzy butterfly with stained-glass wings that glitter in the light.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Silkwing in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
